conditioning: From-zero, same saved prior, RNG, checkpoint and native protocol as S0_REFERENCE_REPLAY; single factor change is region_id from F_b011_s030__reference to F_b011_s030__NO, keeping the parent pointwise operator, dose, window [0.1,0.5] and 100 steps. Region NO is defined by the source terminal N/O role selection at node single_b011_final_030; the generated graph stays free and generated atom identities are not forced to N or O. Evidence clock domain is the complete learning_window [0.0,0.5], distinct from the control window [0.1,0.5]. Regional_context distances are source terminal geometry associations, not proven contacts or interaction energies; same-root controls (n=40) are dependent and there is no same-graph control (n_same_graph=0). Regional_trajectories are retrospective historical-steer pocket-fixed fields, not the current gradient-guided parent run, and their temporal slopes are not spatial reward gradients.
contrast_definition: From t=0 with matched saved random priors, random streams, checkpoint and native protocol; one registered intervention versus its parent. Chemical graphs remain free; historical suffix score levels are not from-zero treatment effects.
falsifier: If the NO-region run under matched prior, RNG, checkpoint and native protocol yields terminal U_tau, best_qualified_pic50, mean_all_pic50 and hit_fraction indistinguishable from the parent reference-region outcome within the paired uncertainty, the region-support hypothesis is not supported. A measured execution response with no terminal separation, or terminal separation accompanied by no measurable change in the NO-support pointwise error, would also falsify the proposed mechanism.
observable_definition: Implemented and derivative-tested: local Hungarian assignment, robust per-point distance to observed teacher coordinates. Units A; no chemical-role or energy assumption.
predicted_execution_response: Measured current-program response only: nonzero coordinate updates on the NO support with assignment switches and point_rms_A comparable in magnitude to the parent response (parent mean point_rms_A 0.169, injected_rms_A_mean 0.0301, no atom or cumulative clipping). No terminal-affinity gradient is implied by this response.
predicted_terminal_response: Proposed, not measured: the from-zero terminal utility and affinity guard for the NO-region run will differ from the parent reference-region outcome (parent U_tau 0.01246, best_qualified_pic50 8.434, mean_all_pic50 7.827, hit_fraction 0.0417, n=24). Direction is not asserted; the parent best_qualified_pic50 is not a forecast for new samples.
scientific_hypothesis: Selecting the NO region (terminal N/O role sites) as the local support for the unchanged pointwise operator will change the from-zero terminal outcome relative to the reference region, because the NO support concentrates the matched local point-distance objective on the terminal N/O role positions rather than the reference support. This is a geometric-support hypothesis only: it does not assert that generated atoms acquire N/O identity, that the listed pocket sites are contacts or hydrogen bonds, or that any source layout score forecasts a generated score.
